memoryBuilder.verseText: Being too proud comes right before a fall.

sequence.prompt: What happened at the tall tower? Put it in order.

items.label: They built a tower to be famous
God came down to look at it

matches.prompt: Match each one to what the story says.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: So small that God came down to see it
Wanting to be big all by yourself

application.question: They wanted everyone to look at them. When do you most want people to notice you?
application.followUp: Wanting to be noticed is very normal. The good news is you do not have to build a tower — God already sees you, and He already loves you.
